items.title: Record fresh canonical host availability evidence for review fallback decisions
items.context: Introduce a command/handler or helper that probes canonical hosts codex, claude, and agy, records availability/version/fresh material binding, and registers the evidence as a process fact so fallback gates can consume it.
items.userSees: `lattice review_host_availability_probe --storyId=<id>` prints a probe id, materialHash, and canonical host rows for codex, claude, and agy with available/path/version/error fields.

happy.desc: Running review_host_availability_probe records a process event bound to current materialHash/storyFilesHash and reports codex, claude, and agy canonical host rows.

edge.desc: Unavailable hosts are recorded as unavailable with an error or missing path instead of being silently omitted, so availableHostCount cannot be inflated by absence.

adversarial.desc: The probe evidence is registered as a gate-consumed process fact; process fact contract verification fails if the command/fact registry is missing.

verificationEvidence.note: Fresh probe B-7438:RHP-mrdfomgf recorded process event bound to current materialHash/storyFilesHash and reported canonical codex, claude, and agy rows; root npm run test also passed after the follow-up smoke fixes.
Review-escalation smoke now includes unavailable-host preservation plus temporary-host-unavailability stale/missing/two-host rejection coverage.
Process fact contract verifies review_host_availability_probe remains an L4 gate-consumed host-availability process fact and root npm run test passed.

items.title: Reject single-host degraded fallback when fresh host proof shows two or more hosts available
items.context: review_escalation_fallback_set and the review escalation/floor evaluators must require a fresh probe for eligibility=single-host-environment and reject it when at least two canonical hosts are executable. explicit-human-approval may still permit lower-assurance degraded fallback, but must be rendered explicitly lower assurance.
items.userSees: If a fresh probe shows two or more canonical hosts available, `lattice review_escalation_fallback_set --eligibility=single-host-environment ...` fails and tells the user to use full 3x2 or explicit-human-approval instead.

happy.desc: single-host-environment fallback is accepted only when the latest fresh host availability probe shows fewer than two executable canonical hosts and the story still has the required 3x1 PASS rounds.

edge.desc: explicit-human-approval with an approvalRef can still produce degraded-single-host lower assurance without proving host scarcity, and reports it as lower assurance rather than full 3x2.

adversarial.desc: Missing, stale, or contradictory host probe evidence makes single-host-environment and temporary-host-unavailability fallback records invalid in both review_escalation_status and review assurance floor evaluation, even if evidenceRefs prose exists.

verificationEvidence.note: Both smokes prove probe-present insufficient-host fallback passes only as degraded-single-host with hostAvailabilityProbeId.
Assurance-floor smoke verifies explicit-human-approval remains lower assurance/non-Authority and does not require host scarcity proof.
Smokes now cover single-host-environment and temporary-host-unavailability missing/stale/two-host rejection; missed storyFilesHash and freshness-root suites are repaired.

items.title: Cover host-proof fallback behavior with smoke tests and user-visible diagnostics
items.context: Add smoke coverage proving missing probe blocks single-host fallback, probe with codex+claude available blocks single-host fallback, insufficient hosts permits the explicit single-host path, and status/DONE diagnostics explain how to run the probe instead of silently accepting prose.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes lines like `missing probe blocks single-host degraded fallback`, `two available canonical hosts reject single-host fallback`, `insufficient hosts permits degraded-single-host`, and `explicit-human-approval remains degraded-single-host, not full-3x2`.

happy.desc: review-escalation smoke proves probe-present insufficient-host fallback passes as degraded-single-host and reports canonical host proof diagnostics.

edge.desc: review-assurance-floor smoke proves explicit-human-approval remains allowed but visibly lower assurance and non-Authority.

adversarial.desc: smoke tests prove missing probe and probe-with-two-available-hosts reject single-host-environment fallback; process fact contract verification covers new command/fact registry entries.

verificationEvidence.note: Review-escalation smoke output includes missing probe, temporary-host-unavailability rejection, insufficient-host degraded pass, two-host rejection, and explicit-human-approval degraded-only cases.
Review-assurance-floor smoke output covers explicit-human-approval as lower assurance, temporary-host-unavailability rejection, and non-Authority/non-production guarantees.
Root npm run test passed after repairing missed review-assurance-floor-storyfileshash and review-escalation-freshness-root smoke suites, so the branch no longer breaks the root test chain.
